ingresso.sottotitolo: The 100% anonymous and secure class diary. No tracking, no arbitrary censorship.

onboarding.step_0_testo: The anonymous digital diary for your class. Here you can tell, laugh, and read stories from your classmates without ever revealing who you truly are.
onboarding.step_1_testo: You register only with a randomly generated nickname and a password. No real name, no email, no phone number. Not even your class Admin can trace your identity.
onboarding.step_2_testo: No real names, no insults, no harmful content. Every chronicle passes through an automated filter and an Admin before publication. Complete rules are always available at the ⚠️ icon above.
onboarding.step_3_testo: This space only works if we all respect it. Report what's inappropriate, request removal if you recognize yourself, and remember: behind every nickname is a real person.

benvenuto.fonda_desc: You will become the ROOT of this class: you can approve chronicles, handle reports, promote other Admins, and ban users. The Class Code will be generated automatically by the system.
benvenuto.spiegazione_sigla: Have a custom code (e.g. 1MAQ, 5MQA1)? Type it in the Custom Name field. Otherwise choose year and section below.
benvenuto.campo_nome_libero: Class name or code (e.g. Rossi High, 1MAQ, 5MQA1...)
benvenuto.accetta_root: I accept the responsibility of being the ROOT and main moderator of the class.
benvenuto.accetta_regole: I accept Community Rules and mutual respect guidelines.
benvenuto.sei_root: Signed in as {{nickname}}, ROOT of this class.
benvenuto.avviso_codice_perso: You won't be able to see it again after leaving this screen. Share it only with your classmates.
benvenuto.motto: Total anonymity. High energy. Protect your identity.

benvenuto.root_avviso_ruolo: You will become the ROOT of this class: you can approve chronicles, manage reports, promote other Admins, and ban users. The Class Code will be generated automatically by the system.
benvenuto.root_responsabilita_testo: As the creator of this class, you are responsible for its moderation: you must review pending chronicles, handle reports fairly, and address abusive behavior. Misuse of these powers may lead to platform intervention.
benvenuto.accetta_root_label: I have read and accept the responsibilities of the ROOT role.
benvenuto.errore_entra_campi: Enter both the Class Code and a password.
benvenuto.errore_password_min: Password must be at least 6 characters.
benvenuto.errore_entra_regole: You must accept the Community Rules to join the class.
benvenuto.errore_classe_numero_sezione: To identify the class with year and section, you must select both (e.g. 3 and C).
benvenuto.errore_classe_obbligatoria: Specify the class name: enter a custom name, select year and section (e.g. 3C), or both.
benvenuto.errore_password_classe: Enter a password to protect the class.
benvenuto.errore_accetta_root: You must accept the ROOT responsibilities to create a class.
benvenuto.errore_accetta_regole: You must accept the Community Rules to proceed.

accedi.compila_campi: Please fill in all fields to sign in.

feed.nessuna_cronaca_desc: Be the first to share something! New chronicles will appear here after Admin approval.

crea_post.spunto_sotto: Tap a prompt to start writing from there (optional):
spunti: Is there something that made you laugh recently?
A secret you want to share?
What was the most awkward moment of the week?
Any funny incident during a lecture?
What would you like to say to the class that you never said?
crea_post.banner_testo: Reminder: Do not use real names, teacher names, or identifying details. Keep it anonymous and fun! Inappropriate content will not be approved.
crea_post.placeholder_textarea: Write your confession, gossip, or vent here. The void is listening...
crea_post.errore_campi: Enter both a title and the content of the chronicle.
crea_post.errore_non_consentito: You cannot publish this chronicle. The text contains words or expressions not allowed by class rules. Please edit to continue.
crea_post.successo: Chronicle submitted! It will be visible once approved by an Admin.

membri.modal_segnala_sottotitolo: Describe inappropriate behavior. Reports are anonymous.
membri.modal_segnala_avviso: Use this tool only for genuine misconduct. False reports or personal vendettas can result in account restrictions.
membri.modal_segnala_placeholder: E.g. repeatedly writing offensive messages toward classmates...

postcard.modal_rimozione_sottotitolo: If you recognize yourself in this post, you can request its removal.
postcard.modal_rimozione_avviso: This action flags the post for review by the admin team. False reports may result in account restrictions.
postcard.modal_rimozione_placeholder: Explain why you request removal (e.g. 'it talks about me and discloses private info')...

admin.accesso_negato_testo: This section is only visible to Admins and the class ROOT. If you believe this is an error, contact your class ROOT to get promoted.
admin.zona_pericolo_desc: Irreversible system actions. Proceed with caution.
admin.autodistruzione_avviso: This action will permanently delete all chronicles, users, and the class itself. It cannot be undone. Download the backup first if you want to keep chronicles.
admin.distruzione_completata: The class and all its data have been permanently deleted. You can close this page or log out.

impostazioni.lingua_desc: Choose your preferred language for the app interface.
impostazioni.tema_desc: Choose the visual appearance of Class Chronicles. Dark theme is the default.
impostazioni.colore_desc: Customize the accent color used for buttons, active borders, and highlights.
impostazioni.elimina_account_desc: This protocol will permanently delete your account. Your chronicles will remain visible but anonymous.
impostazioni.elimina_conferma_desc: This action cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
impostazioni.risorse_desc: Visit our official website or YouTube channel to learn how Class Chronicles works and watch video tutorials.

guida_home.descrizione: Add Class Chronicles to your Home screen to use it like a native app, without opening the browser.

feedback.segnala_problema: Report an issue or send anonymous feedback

bannato.descrizione: Your account has been temporarily suspended by a class Admin.
